scripts.dev: npm run validate:repo-root && npm run dev:all
scripts.dev:backend: npm run validate:repo-root && npm run backend
scripts.dev:staff: npm run validate:repo-root && npm run frontend
scripts.dev:candidate: npm run validate:repo-root && sh -c 'VITE_API_URL=${VITE_API_URL:-http://localhost:${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}/api/v1} VITE_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=${VITE_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}/api/v1/public} npm --silent --prefix candidate-portal run dev'
scripts.dev:all: npm run validate:repo-root && concurrently --names backend,staff,candidate --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "magenta.bold,cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:staff" "npm run dev:candidate"
scripts.frontend: npm run validate:repo-root && sh -c 'VITE_API_URL=${VITE_API_URL:-http://localhost:${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}/api/v1} VITE_API_BASE_URL=${VITE_API_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}} npm --silent --prefix frontend run dev'
scripts.backend:bootstrap: npm run validate:repo-root && cd backend && .venv/bin/python scripts/bootstrap_dev.py
scripts.backend:seed-admin: npm run validate:repo-root && cd backend && .venv/bin/python scripts/seed_dev_admin.py
scripts.backend:seed-jobs: npm run validate:repo-root && cd backend && .venv/bin/python scripts/seed_jobs.py
scripts.backend:seed-scoring: npm run validate:repo-root && cd backend && .venv/bin/python scripts/seed_scoring_version.py
scripts.backend: npm run validate:repo-root && sh -c 'cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn src.interface.api.main:app --reload --reload-dir src --reload-dir scripts --reload-exclude ".venv/*" --reload-exclude "tests/*" --host ${BACKEND_HOST:-0.0.0.0} --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8000} --no-access-log --log-level warning'
scripts.backend:health: sh -c 'printf "aguardando backend em http://127.0.0.1:%s\n" "${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}"; until response=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}/health 2>/dev/null); do sleep 1; done; printf "backend pronto | %s\n" "$response"; case "$response" in *"\"connected\":true"*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.test: npm run validate:repo-root && npm run validate:pipeline-imports
